description: Bundled ABAP Cloud / RAP release-delta knowledge base. One row per verified fact from the 2026-09-09 fact-checked research corpus. Every summary is original abap-mcp prose over a cited source — no SAP or blog text is reproduced. The target system's own release notes remain authoritative.
scopeNote: bundled knowledge curated 2026-09-10; the target system's release notes are authoritative

releaseLabels.pre-2502: before the 2502 release train (established feature, not a 2025-26 delta)
releaseLabels.platform-2025: ABAP Platform 2025 = SAP_BASIS 816 = ABAP 8.16 (S/4HANA 2025 and S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, GA 2025-10-08)

deltas.title: CDS table entities replace DDIC database tables
deltas.summary: Persistence can now be declared in ABAP CDS source instead of the Dictionary editor. SAP positions the CDS table entity as the successor artifact to a DDIC database table for new development.

deltas.title: Writable CDS view entities
deltas.summary: A CDS view entity can be flagged writable, so ABAP SQL modifying statements reach the underlying persistence through the view. Before this a view entity was read-only projection only.
deltas.syntaxSketch:
DEFINE WRITABLE VIEW ENTITY zi_travel_w
  AS SELECT FROM zte_travel { key travel_id, agency_id, total_price }

deltas.title: Writable CDS external entities
deltas.summary: External entities, which project a remote SQL data source into CDS, gained a writable flavour so that outbound modifying statements are possible, not just remote reads.
deltas.syntaxSketch: DEFINE WRITABLE EXTERNAL ENTITY zx_partner { key id : abap.char(10); name : abap.char(40); }

deltas.title: ABAP SQL connection objects (IF_ABAP_SQL_CONNECTION)
deltas.summary: A database connection can be represented as an object whose class implements IF_ABAP_SQL_CONNECTION, then handed to an ABAP SQL statement through a CONNECTION addition instead of a static connection name.
deltas.syntaxSketch: SELECT * FROM zte_travel CONNECTION @con_ref INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_travel).

deltas.title: DECLARE CLIENT addition in the ABAP SQL FROM clause
deltas.summary: The FROM clause can name which column of a source acts as the client column, which matters when a data source is not client-annotated in the Dictionary but must still be handled client-dependently.
deltas.syntaxSketch: SELECT * FROM zsome_source DECLARE CLIENT clnt_col INTO TABLE @DATA(lt).

deltas.title: OPTIONS addition on ABAP SQL DML statements
deltas.summary: Modifying ABAP SQL statements accept an OPTIONS addition, the same escape hatch reads already had, so ABAP-specific behaviour can be requested on INSERT, UPDATE, MODIFY and DELETE.
deltas.syntaxSketch: DELETE FROM zte_travel WHERE agency_id = @lv_agency OPTIONS ( ... ).

deltas.title: Runtime type service for BDEF-derived types
deltas.summary: BDEF-derived types can be built dynamically and type-safely through a runtime type service method, so generic EML code no longer has to hard-code every derived structure it touches.

deltas.title: Custom secondary table keys on BDEF-derived types
deltas.summary: Derived internal table types generated from a behavior definition can carry developer-defined secondary keys, which makes large EML result tables cheaper to read by non-primary-key criteria.

deltas.title: Service definition EXPOSE METHOD for AMDP
deltas.summary: A service definition can expose an AMDP method, widening what a business service may publish beyond CDS entities alone. Sourced from SAP's keyword-documentation delta page rather than the release blog.

deltas.title: Event-driven side effects, link/unlink actions and editable tree hierarchies (cloud line)
deltas.summary: SAP's ABAP 9.14 delta page also lists RAP side effects driven by events, link and unlink actions with inverse functions, editable tree hierarchies and a managed reorder action. Only the keyword page was checked, not a release blog.

deltas.title: Delegated CDS buffering (TYPE DELEGATED)
deltas.summary: A CDS entity can delegate its buffer definition to another entity instead of declaring its own, so a projection stack shares one buffer. Sourced from SAP's keyword-documentation delta page only.
deltas.syntaxSketch:
@AbapCatalog.entityBuffer.definitionAllowed: true
// buffer TYPE DELEGATED to the underlying table entity

deltas.title: Level-based SQL hierarchies and further spatial functions
deltas.summary: The 9.15 delta adds level-based hierarchy generation in ABAP SQL plus more spatial functions on top of the 9.14 geo work. Keyword-documentation sourced, not confirmed against a release blog.

deltas.title: OData UI Service from Scratch generator
deltas.summary: A generator that produces a full OData UI service from a starting point rather than from an existing BO enters the RAP stream. Reported via SAP's RAP What's New page, not a fetched release blog.

deltas.title: Table buffering for CDS table entities (BUFFER ON)
deltas.summary: A CDS table entity can now be buffered. The entity opts in with an AbapCatalog annotation and a separate buffer definition names the entity it buffers.
deltas.syntaxSketch:
@AbapCatalog.entityBuffer.definitionAllowed: true
DEFINE TABLE ENTITY BUFFER ON zte_travel { ... }

deltas.title: ABAP SQL spatial functions mapped to SAP HANA
deltas.summary: Geospatial predicates and measures become first-class ABAP SQL functions that map onto the database's own spatial constructs, so distance and containment work no longer needs native SQL or AMDP.
deltas.syntaxSketch: SELECT site_id, st_distance( geo_a, geo_b ) AS dist FROM zsites INTO TABLE @DATA(lt).

deltas.title: RAP change documents
deltas.summary: A managed RAP business object can record who changed which persisted field into a change document object, giving audit history without hand-written logging code in the save sequence.

deltas.title: System classes for random numbers and probability distributions
deltas.summary: New released system classes cover random-number generation and computation with probability distributions, so simulation and sampling logic no longer needs a hand-rolled generator.

deltas.title: RAP reorder action for editable tree views
deltas.summary: A non-standard operation on an association moves a hierarchy node to a chosen position among its siblings, which is what an editable tree view needs. It can be implemented managed or unmanaged.

deltas.title: Collaborative draft
deltas.summary: Several users can work on the same draft instance at once. This shipped with 2508; the later cross-business-object extension is a separate 2602 delta and is often mis-dated.

deltas.title: Cross-BO transactional enablement
deltas.summary: Behavior definitions can declare a shared cross-business-object context so several BOs commit inside one transaction, instead of each BO owning its own isolated save sequence.

deltas.title: Factory actions now answer HTTP 201 on OData V4
deltas.summary: A successful factory action returns status 201 instead of 200 over OData V4. Any client or test that asserts on 200 breaks after upgrade, so treat this as a behavioural change, not a feature.

deltas.title: ADT creates behavior definitions for CDS table entities
deltas.summary: The development tools can generate a behavior definition directly on a CDS table entity, closing the tooling gap that made table entities awkward as RAP persistence when they first shipped.

deltas.title: RAP BO test double framework auto-fills CID on MODIFY EML
deltas.summary: The business-object test double framework fills the content ID for a MODIFY EML statement automatically, removing a common source of noisy boilerplate in RAP unit tests.

deltas.title: Debugger comparison tool for internal tables
deltas.summary: The debugger gained a side-by-side comparison for two internal tables, which shortens the loop when a RAP determination or a mapping produces almost-but-not-quite the expected rows.

deltas.title: API release consistency and compatibility checks cover BDEF-derived types
deltas.summary: The provider-side ATC checks that police whether a released API changed incompatibly now also inspect BDEF-derived types inside released classes and interfaces.

deltas.title: Logging of C1-released RAP business events
deltas.summary: RAP events released under contract C1 can be logged for local consumption, which gives a system-internal audit trail for events that never leave the system as remote APIs.

deltas.title: Event activities, object relationships and payload-level source filters
deltas.summary: Business events can be grouped into activities, related objects can be viewed together, extensibility status is published in the discovery document, and a source filter can key on payload properties.

deltas.title: New business-event log CDS views, two predecessors deprecated
deltas.summary: Released views C_BUEVLGEVTFULLPYLDJSONDEX_2, C_BUSEVTLOGACTIVITYDEX and C_BUSEVTLOGEVENTDEX_3 replace the earlier log views. Code reading the older two must move before they disappear.

deltas.title: SQL service allows INSERT and DELETE on writable CDS view entities
deltas.summary: The ODBC-facing SQL service stops being read-only: external clients can insert and delete through a writable CDS view entity, which changes the security posture of any exposed SQL service.

deltas.title: Outbound SQL through CDS external entities, with a CSN import wizard
deltas.summary: A remote SQL API described by a CSN definition can be imported by an ADT wizard that generates matching CDS external entities, making the remote source queryable with ordinary ABAP SQL.

deltas.title: ABAP HTTP client and server support server-sent events
deltas.summary: Both sides of the ABAP HTTP stack understand server-sent events, so a long-running ABAP process can stream progress to a browser or a service without polling.

deltas.title: Change-document reuse UI for RAP OData V4 Fiori apps
deltas.summary: A ready-made user interface for browsing change documents can be embedded in a RAP OData V4 Fiori application, pairing with the 2508 change-document language feature.

deltas.title: 2508 available from 16 August 2025
deltas.summary: The 2508 release of the BTP ABAP environment became available on 16 August 2025 and replaced 2505. Highlights called out were table entities as RAP persistence, multi-dimensional reporting and the partner add-on product.

deltas.title: GREATEST, LEAST, COUNT DISTINCT ... OVER and hierarchy null retention
deltas.summary: The 9.16 keyword delta adds GREATEST and LEAST scalar functions, a distinct count as a window function, and null retention in hierarchies. Keyword-documentation sourced, not confirmed against a release blog.
deltas.syntaxSketch: SELECT id, greatest( a, b ) AS hi, count( DISTINCT dept ) OVER( ) AS n FROM ztab INTO TABLE @DATA(lt).

deltas.title: Hierarchy copy, create-by-association authorization and privileged cross-BO reads
deltas.summary: The 9.16 RAP delta lists copying a hierarchy, authorization control on create-by-association, selectively disabling authorization for determinations and validations, draft scope and event delivery retries.

deltas.title: JSON source and result options on CALL TRANSFORMATION
deltas.summary: Serialization gained JSON-specific source and result options, so a transformation can consume or produce JSON without an intermediate XML round trip. Keyword-documentation sourced only.

deltas.title: Stricter association rules for CDS custom entities
deltas.summary: Conditions allowed on associations of a custom entity were tightened in 9.16, alongside static external entities and static caches. Existing custom entities may need adjustment on upgrade.

deltas.title: RAP change documents surface as business events
deltas.summary: Changes already recorded as RAP change documents can be published as business events, so downstream consumers subscribe to the change stream instead of polling the log tables.

deltas.title: EML read entity ... with changes ... result data(rdc)
deltas.summary: An EML read can ask for the change operations recorded on a data record, either for all fields or a named subset, returning them in a dedicated result structure alongside the data.
deltas.syntaxSketch:
READ ENTITY zi_travel
  WITH CHANGES ( all fields )
  ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
  RESULT DATA(result) DATA(rdc).

deltas.title: RAP global side effects
deltas.summary: Interdependencies that span the whole business object can be declared so the user interface reloads as a unit. The end user can also trigger the reload with a dedicated keystroke.

deltas.title: Partner classic APIs recognized by the Usage of APIs check
deltas.summary: Certified partners can register their own classic APIs so customer code calling them is not flagged. Enablement runs through SAP Note 3630552 and the check parameter partnerAPIDataSources.

deltas.title: Read-only Fiori analytical table for RAP
deltas.summary: A read-only analytical table combines transactional data with light analytical capability in a RAP application. Reported from the release blog without an independent fact-check pass.

deltas.title: SQL indicators, a CSV writer and garbage-collection support
deltas.summary: The 9.17 keyword delta lists SQL indicators, a CSV writer class and new garbage-collection support. Keyword-documentation sourced, not confirmed against a release blog.

deltas.title: 2511 available from 15 November 2025
deltas.summary: The 2511 release of the BTP ABAP environment became available on 15 November 2025 as the successor to 2508.

deltas.title: Collaborative draft extended across business objects
deltas.summary: Concurrent draft editing, which arrived in 2508 for one business object, now spans cross-business-object scenarios where both participants carry full draft scope.

deltas.title: RAP Recommendations, optionally generative-AI backed
deltas.summary: Field-level input assistance can be produced either by deterministic rules or by a language model reached through the ABAP AI SDK under Intelligent Scenario Lifecycle Management.

deltas.title: CDS embedded analytics star schema generator
deltas.summary: A wizard generates the transactional, cube and dimension views of an embedded-analytics star schema, so the analytical modelling layer no longer has to be hand-written view by view.

deltas.title: Manage API Snapshots app for released-API providers
deltas.summary: A provider of released APIs can export an API snapshot from one system and import it into another, so an incompatible change to a released object is caught during development rather than after transport.

deltas.title: Test double framework enhancements
deltas.summary: The 2602 notes list unspecified enhancements to the test double frameworks under testability. No individual feature was named, so treat this as a pointer to check the target system's own notes.

deltas.title: AI-powered ATC Explain in the custom code analysis app
deltas.summary: Findings can be explained in place by Joule inside the custom code analysis application. The capability needs an extra licence per SAP Note 3571857 and is desktop only.

deltas.title: 2602 delivered on 14 February 2026
deltas.summary: The 2602 release of the BTP ABAP environment was delivered on 14 February 2026 as the successor to 2511.

deltas.title: Draft on table entities: CDS table entities as RAP draft persistence
deltas.summary: A managed draft-enabled business object can keep its draft rows in a CDS table entity. Until 2605 a table entity could only serve as active persistence for a business object without draft.

deltas.title: Feature control attributes readonly:create and mandatory:update
deltas.summary: Two static feature-control attributes let a field be read-only only while creating, or mandatory only while updating, instead of forcing one blanket rule across every operation.
deltas.syntaxSketch:
field ( readonly : create ) travel_id;
field ( mandatory : update ) booking_status;

deltas.title: Clean-core analysis on ECC and S/4HANA via ABAP_CLEAN_CORE_READINESS
deltas.summary: The release notes announce running clean-core analysis against ECC and S/4HANA systems with this variant. The variant name itself is older; what changed is the supported target landscape.

deltas.title: Support of boolean expressions
deltas.summary: Boolean expressions become usable directly where previously a comparison had to be wrapped in xsdbool or an IF. Listed in the 2605 release notes without further detail.

deltas.title: Recursive references in the ABAP type system
deltas.summary: A structure may reference its own type, which makes tree-shaped and linked-list data expressible directly instead of through generic references plus casting.

deltas.title: DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES without a preceding sort
deltas.summary: Duplicate removal on an internal table no longer requires sorting first, which removes the classic sort-then-delete pairing and the bugs that come from forgetting the sort.
deltas.syntaxSketch: DELETE DUPLICATES FROM lt_travel COMPARING agency_id.

deltas.title: XCO generation API for CDS table entities
deltas.summary: CDS table entities can be created programmatically through the XCO generation API, which is what a generator or a migration tool needs in order to create persistence without the ADT wizard.

deltas.title: Signature comparison when migrating DDIC-based views to CDS view entities
deltas.summary: The migration tooling compares the signature of the old view with the generated view entity, which surfaces silent field or type drift before the replacement is activated.

deltas.title: Tree table as a business configuration table type
deltas.summary: A business configuration object can be modelled as a tree table, so hierarchical configuration is maintainable in the standard configuration app rather than a custom screen.

deltas.title: ATC integrates with ChaRM and scales elastically
deltas.summary: Check results can be tied into change request management, and check runs can be spread across elastically scaled processes so a large central run finishes in reasonable time.

deltas.title: ADT for VS Code ships independently of the backend release
deltas.summary: SAP states that the first delivery of the VS Code development tools is decoupled from the ABAP backend release and rolls out on its own cadence, unlike the Eclipse plug-in's traditional pairing.

deltas.title: Minimum ABAP runtime size cut to 0.5 ACU, new regions
deltas.summary: The smallest bookable ABAP runtime drops to half an ABAP compute unit, a multi-availability-zone HANA Cloud option appears, and two Azure regions (Toronto and Frankfurt) are added.

deltas.title: SET_BLOCK_COMMIT on the ABAP SQL connection interface
deltas.summary: The connection interface gained a method to block commits on that connection, which matters when a secondary connection must not participate in the surrounding transaction. Keyword-documentation sourced only.

deltas.title: Access control applied directly on draft tables
deltas.summary: The 9.19 RAP delta reports that data control language can be defined on draft tables themselves, tightening who may read another user's draft rows. Keyword-documentation sourced only.

deltas.title: 2605 delivered on 16 May 2026
deltas.summary: The 2605 release of the BTP ABAP environment was delivered on 16 May 2026 as the successor to 2602.

deltas.title: VS Code ABAP tooling covers more object types
deltas.summary: The 2608 notes describe a wider object-type footprint for the VS Code extension: dictionary objects, function groups and modules, behavior definition extensions and inline help. Search-snippet sourced; the release blog could not be fetched.

deltas.title: DEFAULT values on CDS external entities
deltas.summary: External entities accept default values for elements in 9.20, which matters when a remote source omits a column the ABAP consumer expects. Keyword-documentation sourced only.

deltas.title: TYPE ANY STRUCTURE and TYPE ANY STRUCTURE CONTAINING
deltas.summary: A generic formal parameter can be constrained to any structured type, optionally one containing named components, which is stricter than plain TYPE ANY. Keyword-documentation sourced only.
deltas.syntaxSketch: METHODS process IMPORTING is_data TYPE ANY STRUCTURE CONTAINING travel_id.

deltas.title: CALL TRANSFORMATION options name_handling and name_escaping
deltas.summary: Serialization gains two options that control how ABAP names are mapped and escaped in the produced document, which helps when a downstream schema demands a specific casing. Keyword-documentation sourced only.

deltas.title: 2608 platform highlights
deltas.summary: Reported highlights include adjustable start of technical downtime in the upgrade app, migration of business roles to IAM roles, units of measure in custom business configurations, OData binding types in service bindings, and My Home as the single entry page.

deltas.title: 2608 delivered on 15 August 2026
deltas.summary: 2608 is reported as delivered on 15 August 2026 and is the current BTP ABAP environment release as of the curation date. The release blog itself was not fetchable, so this rests on search snippets.

deltas.title: Advanced variant configuration in the Solution Order OData V4 API
deltas.summary: The RAP-based create, read, update, delete and simulation API for solution orders fully supports advanced variant configuration, and the product master API was extended for configuration create and update.

deltas.title: S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2608 ships 17 AI-assisted features
deltas.summary: SAP's 35th major cloud ERP release makes seventeen base AI-assisted features generally available, including AI-assisted easy fill for Fiori elements apps, with several agents targeted at the 2608.2 wave.

deltas.title: RAP events for outbound, inbound and returns deliveries
deltas.summary: Developer extensibility can subscribe to delivery events: created, changed and deleted plus finer-grained ones such as picking status changed or item created for outbound deliveries.

deltas.title: ABAP Platform 2025 is SAP_BASIS 816, not "ABAP 9"
deltas.summary: The platform under S/4HANA 2025 and S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 2025 is SAP_BASIS 816, that is ABAP release 8.16 with kernel 916, generally available on 8 October 2025. SAP names platforms by calendar year.

deltas.title: Two ABAP release lines: 8.1x on-stack and 9.x cloud
deltas.summary: The 8.1x releases are based on 7.58 and belong to the on-stack platform, while the 9.x numbers belong to the BTP ABAP environment. There is no product called ABAP 9; 9.16 simply means the 2508 cloud release.

deltas.title: Cloud release mapping 9.14/2502 through 9.20/2608
deltas.summary: The BTP ABAP environment quarterly trains map to ABAP releases as 9.14/2502, 9.15/2505, 9.16/2508, 9.17/2511, 9.18/2602, 9.19/2605 and 9.20/2608. Cloud and S/4HANA trains are related but not interchangeable.

deltas.title: ABAP Cloud generators for OData UI services from a RAP BO
deltas.summary: On-stack generators produce an OData UI service from an existing RAP business object, with or without AI assistance, so the service and projection layer no longer has to be typed by hand.

deltas.title: CDS table entities as active persistence for managed BOs without draft
deltas.summary: On ABAP Platform 2025 a managed business object without draft can persist into a CDS table entity instead of a classic dictionary table. Draft persistence on table entities is a separate, later cloud delta.

deltas.title: Collaborative draft handling on ABAP Platform 2025
deltas.summary: Concurrent multi-user editing of one draft instance is part of the 2025 on-stack RAP investment, matching the capability the cloud line received in its 2508 train.

deltas.title: Cross-BO transactional scenarios through cross-BO associations
deltas.summary: Associations that cross business-object boundaries can be made transactionally aware on ABAP Platform 2025, so a composite scenario commits as one unit rather than as chained independent saves.

deltas.title: Read-only and editable tree views with drag, drop, reorder and cascading delete
deltas.summary: Hierarchical RAP user interfaces gained drag and drop, cut and paste, reordering and cascading delete, which is what makes a tree usable for maintenance rather than display only.

deltas.title: Event-driven RAP side effects for asynchronous updates
deltas.summary: Side effects can be triggered by events so a user interface refreshes after asynchronous work completes, instead of only after a synchronous round trip finished.

deltas.title: Privileged context propagates into subsequent EML requests
deltas.summary: A privileged execution context now carries into the reading and modifying EML calls that follow, removing the pattern of re-declaring privileged mode at every hop of a call chain.
deltas.syntaxSketch:
MODIFY ENTITIES OF zi_travel PRIVILEGED
  ENTITY Travel UPDATE FIELDS ( total_price ) WITH lt_update.

deltas.title: AMDP test double framework
deltas.summary: A dedicated framework for doubling AMDP methods arrives with ABAP Platform 2025. Before it, database procedure logic was one of the hardest parts of an application to unit test offline.

deltas.title: CDS test double framework covers hierarchy views
deltas.summary: CDS hierarchies join the set of entities the CDS test double framework can replace, which makes hierarchy-based reporting logic testable without live hierarchy data.

deltas.title: What the CDS test double framework can double
deltas.summary: Doubles exist for dictionary tables and views, CDS views and view entities with parameters, projection and external views, table functions, currency and unit conversion, shared tables, session variables, hierarchies, table entities and static external entities.

deltas.title: ABAP Memory and Memory Snapshot debugger views
deltas.summary: The debugger gained a memory view and a snapshot list, plus the internal-table comparison tool that had already reached the cloud line in its 2508 train.

deltas.title: CDS updatable view entities wrap existing tables
deltas.summary: An updatable view entity can wrap a dictionary table or a CDS table entity and expose a native CDS signature that ABAP SQL and access control can use, which is a practical bridge for classic persistence.

deltas.title: Static CDS external entities for consumption scenarios
deltas.summary: Static external entities let a remote data source be consumed with a fixed, design-time-known signature, complementing the writable external entities the cloud line received in 2502.

deltas.title: CDS generation wizard for hierarchical data
deltas.summary: A wizard automates creating hierarchically structured CDS artifacts. The cloud line received an equivalent hierarchy generation wizard in its 2508 train.

deltas.title: AI-powered CDS Explain
deltas.summary: Development tools can produce semantic context about a CDS entity on demand. It is an explanation aid, not a code generator, and it is one of the Joule-family capabilities rather than a language feature.

deltas.title: RAP business events predate the 2025-26 window
deltas.summary: Events are declared in a behavior definition and raised in the late save phase after the point of no return; an event binding maps them to a namespace, object and operation. This dates to the 2208 stream, not to 2508.

deltas.title: Local RAP events can be C1-released, event bindings C2
deltas.summary: A local event may be exposed under release contract C1 when the business object interface is released. For remote events it is the event binding that carries the C2 remote-API contract.

deltas.title: Late numbering is an established RAP concept
deltas.summary: Late numbering assigns the final key only just before the record is written, which is what gap-free business identifiers such as invoice numbers require. It sits alongside early and managed numbering and is not a 2025-26 novelty.

deltas.title: RAP BO interfaces are not a 2025-26 feature
deltas.summary: Business object interfaces entered the RAP stream around 2205. Later releases widened generation and extension scenarios around them, so do not present them as new in this window.

deltas.title: RAP prechecks are not a 2025-26 feature
deltas.summary: The precheck concept predates the 2502 to 2608 window. Attribute it to a specific narrower enhancement or leave it out of a release-delta answer entirely.

deltas.title: RAP large-object support is not a 2025-26 feature
deltas.summary: Handling of large objects in RAP predates the window. Newer releases add surrounding service and runtime capability rather than introducing the concept itself.

deltas.title: Background Processing Framework is not new in 2608
deltas.summary: The background processing framework provides transactional, queued asynchronous execution and integrates with RAP transaction control. It is an existing platform capability, not a 2608 arrival.
